title: Qatle sarwar hai aaj waawaila
body:
Qatle sarwar hai aaj waawaila
roze mehshar hai aaj waawaila
bosa gaahe rasool par rakhta
shimr qanjar hai aaj waawaila
<<DIVIDER>>
khul gaya fatima ka jannat me
sub'ha se sar hai aaj waawaila
bosa gaahe rasool maqtal me
zere qanjar hai aaj waawaila
<<DIVIDER>>
lut raha maarya ke jungle me
shaah ka ghar hai aaj waawaila
